documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015- ZINQUEST

analysis.summary: Hindustan Zinc reported strong operational and financial performance for the first quarter of FY27, achieving record quarterly EBITDA of INR8,074 crores and a net profit of INR5,469 crores. The company maintained its annual production guidance of 1.1 million tons and highlighted progress on various expansion and sustainability initiatives. Management also discussed market conditions, input costs, and capital allocation priorities during the earnings call. Hindustan Zinc reported a strong performance in Q1FY27, achieving its highest-ever first-quarter mined metal production of 268 KT and record net profit of ₹ 5,469 crore. The company is expanding its refined metal capacity from 1,129 KTPA to 1,379 KTPA at Debari and mined metal capacity to 1,510 KTPA across mines, with target completion by 2QFY29.

guidance.claim: The company maintained its annual production guidance of 1.1 million tons.
guidance.quote: So roughly, we have given a guidance of 1.1 million tons for the year, right?

guidance.claim: Growth projects including the hot acid leaching plant and fertilizer plant are on track to be completed by the second quarter.
guidance.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

guidance.claim: The guidance for growth capex for the year is expected to be around USD500 million to USD600 million.
guidance.quote: So the guidance for the year is on the growth project is around USD500 million to USD600 million we are expecting.

guidance.claim: The company plans to expand its mined metal capacity from 1,180 KTPA to 1,510 KTPA across mines.
guidance.quote: Mined metal capacity expansion: 1,180 KTPA to 1,510 KTPA across mines

guidance.claim: The company expects to complete its 510 KTPA Fertilizer Plant by 2QFY27.
The company expects mined metal production for FY27 to be 1,150 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT.
guidance.quote: Looking into the year ahead, with a well-structured capex roadmap in place, we are confident in sustaining this strong performance in the year ahead with an expected mined metal production of 1,150 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, and a refined metal production of 1,100 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, with an expected refined silver production of 680 tons, plus or minus 10 tons.

guidance.claim: Zinc cost of production excluding royalty for FY27 is guided at $975 to $1,000 per ton.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we have guided zinc cost of production excluding royalty at $975 to $1,000 per ton, reflecting prevailing global uncertainties.

demand_outlook.claim: India remains one of the fastest-growing major economies supported by resilient domestic demand and government capital expenditure.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to remain one of the fastest-growing major economies despite an evolving global backdrop.

demand_outlook.claim: Base metal markets remained relatively resilient during the quarter supported by constrained mine supply and steady demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Against a backdrop of geopolitical uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics, base metal markets remained relatively resilient during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver fundamentals remain supported by robust industrial demand from solar, electronics, and electrification applications.
demand_outlook.quote: Nevertheless, silver fundamentals remain supported by robust industrial demand from solar, electronics and electrification applications alongside continued investment interest.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic zinc demand is expected to strengthen as domestic steel production capacity expands to 300 MTPA by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic zinc demand strengthens as domestic steel production capacity expands to 300 MTPA by 2030

demand_outlook.claim: The global energy transition is structurally accelerating the demand for zinc.
demand_outlook.quote: Global energy transition accelerates zinc demand structurally

demand_outlook.claim: India's manufacturing PMI sustained strong momentum above 55 levels during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Moving to the market development, India continues to remain a standout among major economies with manufacturing PMI sustaining strong momentum above 55 levels during the year.

demand_outlook.claim: India's GDP growth for FY 2027 is expected to remain resilient at around 6.4% to 6.9%.
demand_outlook.quote: The country's GDP growth for FY 2027 is expected to remain resilient at around 6.4% to 6.9% supported by continued government capex, infrastructure push, and robust domestic consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains supported by robust industrial demand from solar and electronics.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver, however, continues to stand out, maintaining strong momentum supported by robust industrial demand, particularly from solar and electronics, alongside continued investor interest.

capex_expansion.claim: For the tailings reprocessing plant, construction activities have started and site mobilization for infrastructure development is completed.
capex_expansion.quote: For the tailings reprocessing plant, construction activities have started and site mobilization for the infrastructure development is completed.

capex_expansion.claim: Around INR500 crores has already been spent on the fertilizer plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Around INR500 crores we had already spent.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has approved an investment of ₹ 3,823 crore for India's first zinc tailings reprocessing plant.
Planned capital expenditure for FY27 is in the range of $500 million to $600 million towards announced growth projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Planned capital expenditure for FY27 is in the range of $500 million to $600 million towards announced growth projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Site mobilization is complete and detailed engineering is largely finalized for the 250,000 tons per annum integrated zinc smelter at Debari.
capex_expansion.quote: On the growth projects front, we are making steady progress for the 250,000 tons per annum integrated zinc smelter at Debari. Site mobilization is complete and detailed engineering is largely finalized.

capex_expansion.claim: Site work for the tailings reprocessing plant at Rampura Agucha has commenced, with engineering completed.
capex_expansion.quote: At Rampura Agucha, site work for the tailings reprocessing plant has commenced, with engineering completed.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved the lowest quarterly zinc cost of production excluding royalty since underground transition at USD851 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: On the cost front, despite the volatile geopolitical environment, we achieved the lowest quarterly zinc cost of production, excluding royalty, since underground transition to USD851 per ton, reflecting a decline of 16% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Power and fuel costs increased sequentially due to lower materialization of linkage coal and higher costs of imported coal.
margins_costs.quote: So the power and fuel cost during the quarter has dincreased majorly due to our materialization of linkage coal, which is slightly lower due to the various reasons, including the mine conditions from where we take coal.

margins_costs.claim: On a full year basis, the company delivered a five-year low cost of production at $959 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: On a full year basis, we delivered a five-year low cost of production at $959 per ton, well below our guidance of $1,000 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Shortage of natural gas resulted in a marginally higher cost in Q4 of around $11 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: It is a marginally higher cost in the Q4, maybe around $11 per ton, but on the production point of view, no impact.

orders_capacity.claim: Refined metal production was 260,000 tons for the quarter, up 4% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: alongside refined metal production of 260,000 tons, which was up 4% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Silver production for the quarter stood at 149 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: We achieved 149 tons of silver production in line with the lead production and our silver portfolio continues to contribute 46% to overall profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company possesses the world's second-largest zinc and lead metal reserves and resources with over 25 years of mine life.
orders_capacity.quote: World’s 2nd Largest Zinc & Lead Metal Reserves & Resources with 25+ years of mine life

orders_capacity.claim: Mined metal production reached a record 315 KT and refined metal production reached 282 KT during the fourth quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Turning to operational performance, we delivered a record-breaking quarter with mined metal production at 315 KT and refined metal production of 282 KT.

orders_capacity.claim: Full year mined metal production was 1.1 million tons and refined metal production was 1,048 KT.
orders_capacity.quote: This led to historic full year performance with mined metal at 1.1 million tons and second highest refined metal of 1,048 KT.

orders_capacity.claim: Quarterly silver production stood at 176 tons, up 11.0% sequentially.
orders_capacity.quote: Our quarterly silver production stood at 176 tons, up 11.0% sequentially.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended this quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores, providing significant financial flexibility to pursue value-accretive growth opportunities while maintaining an attractive shareholder return profile.

capital_allocation.claim: The company paid its first interim dividend of INR11 per share during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Reflecting our confidence in the business and strong cash generation, during the quarter, the company paid its first interim dividend of INR11 per share, reaffirming our commitment to delivering sustainable shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital allocation priorities remain investing in high-return growth opportunities, maintaining balance sheet strength, and returning surplus cash to shareholders.
capital_allocation.quote: Our capital allocation priorities remain unchanged: investing in high-return growth opportunities, maintaining balance sheet strength and returning surplus cash to shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to minimize its working capital days.
The company closed the year with a net cash position of INR5,594 crores as of March '26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strong cash generation enabled us to close the year with a net cash position of INR5,594 crores as of March '26, compared to a net debt position of INR1,169 crores at the close of the last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the first interim dividend of INR11 per share, amounting to around INR4,300 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: And out of that, Board has approved the first interim dividend of INR11, which is around INR4,300 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Total capex for the full year was INR3,600 crores, out of which growth capex was INR2,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Total capex was INR3,600 crores for the full year and growth capex was INR2,000 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Hedge losses for the quarter were to the tune of INR200 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the hedge losses are to the tune of INR200 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global macroeconomic environment continues to be influenced by geopolitical development, evolving trade policies, and uneven economic growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global macroeconomic environment continues to be influenced by geopolitical development, evolving trade policies and uneven economic growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company lost an employee of a business partner due to an unexpected man-machine interaction at the Zawar mines on January 25, 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before we begin, it is with deep sorrow that I share an unfortunate incident at our Zawar mines on 25th of January 2026, wherein we lost an employee of our business partner due to an unexpected man-machine interaction.

management_commitments.claim: The phosphoric acid plant portion of the fertilizer plant is expected to be commissioned in the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So what will get commissioned in Q2 is the phosphoric acid portion of the of the fertilizer plant.

management_commitments.claim: The complete fertilizer plant is expected to come in place by the first quarter of next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Fertilizer plant should come in place by quarter 1 of next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the Hot Acid Leaching process is expected in 2Q FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: Given its complexity as a first-of-its-kind project in India, commissioning is now expected in 2Q FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The fertilizer project is on track for commissioning in early 2Q FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: The fertilizer project is also on track for commissioning in early 2Q FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Renewable energy share will reach 70% round the clock by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: 70% is by FY28 as we committed earlier as well as part of our sustainability goals.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
